risks.name: Bold Venture
risks.description: Enemies deal -15% Damage and take +15% Damage but gain +15% Movement Speed, Attack Speed, and Fire Rate.

deviation.name: Glyph Inflation
deviation.description: The security system requires twice as many Vosphene Glyphs to activate.

risks.name: Postmortal Surges
risks.description: Slain enemies burts with Void energy.

risks.name: Alluring Arcocanids
risks.description: As Rogue Arcocanids charge attacks, they pull Warframes towards them.

deviation.name: Coordinated Front
deviation.description: Eximus units support The Fragmented Tide and its final form.

risks.name: Fortified Foes
risks.description: Guardian Eximus units may be encountered, including Guardian Eximus Necramechs.

risks.name: Entanglement
risks.description: Allies within 4m of slain enemies endure reduced Movement Speed and Parkour Velocity.

personalModifiers.name: Permanent Injury
personalModifiers.description: Max health reduced each time health damage is taken

personalModifiers.name: Fractured Armor
personalModifiers.description: Casting an ability reduces armor by 10% for 10s.

personalModifiers.name: Undersupplied
personalModifiers.description: Max ammo on all weapons reduced by 75%

personalModifiers.name: Knifestep Syndrome
personalModifiers.description: Lose 2 Health when moving. Jumping pauses the effect.

deviation.name: Sealed Armor
deviation.description: Enemies take 90% less damage from non-Weak Point hits.

risks.name: Balloonfest
risks.description: Scaldra Harbingers are more numerous and attack and move more quickly.

risks.name: Dense Fog
risks.description: Efervon gas blankets the level. Enemies may drop filters that can provide a temporary reprieve.

deviation.name: Sporogenesis
deviation.description: Techrot Tumors appear near Hell-Scrubbers, increasing the rate of life support decay with each active tumor.

risks.name: Competitive Streak
risks.description: Random negative penalties from Amir and Aoi's "Faceoff" mode will be applied throughout the mission.

deviation.name: Vampire Rock
deviation.description: Flare creates a field that disrupts player abilities while draining energy to boost Flare's health. Flare slowly loses health when no players are in range.

risks.name: Arcade Automate
risks.description: Enemy guns launch large, slow moving orbs instead of their usual ordnance.

risks.name: Beyond The Wall
risks.description: Murmur enemies join Scaldra and Techrot forces.

personalModifiers.name: Untreatable
personalModifiers.description: Pickups do not heal, and Health Orbs cannot be picked up.

personalModifiers.name: Hypersensitive
personalModifiers.description: Duration of negative Status Effects is tripled

personalModifiers.name: Framecurse syndrome
personalModifiers.description: Activating an Ability inflicts 50 damage upon you.

personalModifiers.name: Energy Exhaustion
personalModifiers.description: Lose 2 Energy per second for each enemy within 10 meters of you.
